g.text: WO-3 — one world (seed 13): steady attrition vs synchronized crashes

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0c0e10; opacity: 0.62

g.text: Same world under both regimes. Bars = deaths per tick (stacked by cause); line = population. A3 settles flat under a steady death hum; A4 never settles — it oscillates, with deaths bursting through the down-phases (Fano ≈ 5 vs 2).
